Chapter 945: Chapter 9: The Twelve Layers Of Other Races (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 945: Chapter 9: The Twelve Layers of Other Races (Please Subscribe)_2

“It is much simpler than the three Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage.”

As Lin Yuan mused, he began to comprehend them deeply.

[Your insight is against the natural order; comprehending the Cycle of Life and Death Seal, reaching Level Eleven Perfect Layer]

[Your insight is against the natural order; comprehending the Falcon God’s Blade, reaching Level Eleven Perfect Layer]

[Your insight is against the natural order; comprehending the Nine Refined Featherkill, reaching Level Eleven Perfect Layer]

…

In less than a month, Lin Yuan managed to enhance all the secret techniques he could practice to their limits.

“Among my many techniques, the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Rend Heaven’ is the strongest.” Lin Yuan assessed himself.

‘Rend Heaven’ is an extreme offensive technique with no superfluous effects, simply tearing apart everything before one’s eyes.

However, there are some restrictions on activating this Physical Body Divine Ability, so it still needs the support of many other secret techniques. Moreover, ‘Rend Heaven’ as Lin Yuan’s ultimate trump card, is definitely reserved for the last crucial moment.

With Lin Yuan’s current profound foundation, a single strike of ‘Rend Heaven’ is powerful enough to unleash a might of one million or even several million points of combat strength, and this is the pure ‘Rend Heaven’, without the enhancement of any supreme weapons.

“Even the ultimate avatar of the Twelfth Layer can be easily torn apart before me, and even if they were of the Twelfth Layer, they would likely be injured if they took it head-on.”

Lin Yuan gained a rough understanding of himself.

Of course, this is the ‘Rend Heaven’ Divine Skill utilised by his true body. If it were performed by his two Great Primordial Spirits, the power would likely be somewhat diminished.

…

The vast battlefield.

An Eternal Spatial Rift.

A figure silently emerges.

Every large battlefield is under the scrutiny of the ultimate peak of Twelfth Layer, but this figure’s aura merged with the depths of time and space, eluding even the perception of the ultimate apex of Twelfth Layer.

“I have finally returned.”

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit appears and with a wave of his hand retrieves the avatar that brought back many gains.

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan always felt a sense of danger, but within the confines of the universe, his heart was sure. This place could be said to be absolutely safe.

Those who are at the level of Sovereign Realm and Chaos Realm cannot invade a universe. The Chaos Void has nurtured universes upon universes, and to invade one is akin to defying the will of the Chaos Void.

“Let’s go.”

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit directly enters the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

In the deepest part of the secret realm.

Lin Yuan’s true body sits cross-legged.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit appears, with a palm-sized island floating before him.

It is the Cave Mansion Island of the peak Sovereign Realm powerhouse ‘Cang Weiyang’.

“First, let’s refine the weapons of the Path Splitting Realm.” Lin Yuan immediately took out the few weapons of the Path Splitting Realm from the Cave Mansion and began to refine them quickly.

As for treasures of the Sovereign Realm and Chaos Realm? With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he is not yet qualified to refine them.

Treasures of the Sovereign Realm and Chaos Realm have already birthed a ‘spirit’, possessing the ability to revive and inhale and exhale autonomously.

That piece of ‘White Paper’ originating from the Taiyuan Relics contains a Two-dimensional World within, capable of easily reducing everything nearby to lower dimensions. However, to reduce a Sovereign Realm treasure weapon to lower dimensions? The latter has a ‘spirit’ and can resist and break free.

A Sovereign Realm treasure weapon is already equivalent to half a living being.

Therefore, the rare treasures within the Two-dimensional World of the ‘White Paper’ are mostly of the Path Splitting Twelfth Layer, with not a single treasure from the Sovereign or Chaos Realm.

Next.

Lin Yuan arrives at the Cave Mansion Island and stands before the eighteen peculiar trees.

Each tree bears Spirit Fruits which contain tremendous energy.

Lin Yuan picks all the Spirit Fruits and solemnly stores them away.

“These Spirit Fruits can be used for nourishment needed by the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to enter the ultimate Twelfth Layer of cultivation.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

By now, he also knew how extremely difficult it was to cultivate the “Xuanhuang Physique” to Level Twelve Perfect.

The spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had told Lin Yuan that a Level Twelve Perfect “Xuanhuang Physique” could easily withstand the great destruction calamity of the universe.

This was outright nonsense; if the “Xuanhuang Physique” reached Level Twelve Perfect, such a degree of physical strength, even among the Chaos Great Saints, would be considered formidable, not to mention resisting a minor universal catastrophe—such physical form wouldn’t be affected in the slightest by the destruction of tens, hundreds, or even thousands of universes.

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts; cultivating the “Xuanhuang Physique” to Level Twelve Perfect required an abundance of resources, especially since Lin Yuan’s foundational physical strength was extremely robust, necessitating even more resources than a typical Level Twelve Perfect “Xuanhuang Physique.”

But the Chaos Void is boundless and contains infinite resources; as long as Lin Yuan is strong enough, one day he will gather the necessary abundance.

“These strange trees can absorb Chaos Qi on their own?” Lin Yuan observed the eighteen peculiar trees, noting that their roots penetrated the depths of space-time, imbibing massive amounts of Chaos Qi at every moment.

The Chaos Qi of the Chaos Void is incredibly violent and disordered, containing immense energy, which is why Chaos Stones containing stable and pure Chaos Qi are used as ‘currency.’

Even the powerhouses of the Chaos Realm dare not recklessly absorb the Chaos Qi from the Chaos Void.

Yet these eighteen peculiar trees at the pinnacle of the ruler realm can actually assimilate such Chaos Qi?

[Your comprehension defies the heavens; observing the process of Chaos Qi assimilation enhances your perception of the essence of Chaos Qi…]

Lin Yuan watched carefully as the essence of each wisp of Chaos Qi unraveled in front of him.

“Is it a special life structure?” Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

He felt that if he continued to ponder, he would be able to absorb any Chaos Qi without any concerns, just like these eighteen peculiar trees.

…

In the dim grand hall.

More than ten beings of different races who had reached Level Twelve gathered once again.

“How’s the investigation?” The ultimate being of the Prison Tribe looked around and directly asked.

Since they parted last time, the Level Twelve apexes returned to their respective races and began a thorough investigation into the pathway of Martial Tao evolution.

If the information about the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter was true, it would cause irreversible effects on their peak tribal forces, as the rate at which high-level evolvers of human civilization were born would be terrifyingly high.

“According to my tribe’s intelligence, the likelihood that the founder of the Martial Tao evolution pathway is the Galaxy Master is 95%,” the ultimate being of the Tianyu Clan spoke.

Although the Galaxy Master is a peerless evolutionary genius and the path he’s taken should be a complete and stable one, the fact that both the Galaxy Master and the Martial Tao evolution pathway originated from Canglan Star cannot be overlooked.

Moreover, every time the Galaxy Master was about to advance to a higher level, new chapters of Martial Tao evolution pathway would be uploaded, solidifying that the Galaxy Master was indeed the founder.

“The Galaxy Master is the founder of the Martial Tao evolution pathway; my tribe predicted this result hundreds of years ago,” said the ultimate being of the Cosmos Tribe. The other Level Twelve apexes also appeared calm, displaying no surprise.

It was not just their peak tribes that had noticed; even within human civilization, as the Galaxy Master rapidly grew stronger—Eighth Layer, Ninth Layer, Tenth Layer—voices linking the Galaxy Master with the founder of Martial Tao became louder and louder.

Therefore, this matter was not a secret to the peak tribes.

However.

Until the Martial Tao evolution pathway had ascended to the Level Eleven pathway, the apexes of the different races at Level Twelve didn’t take this pathway seriously.

Even if the Galaxy Master truly was the founder of this evolution pathway, whether or not he could leverage it to step into Level Twelve was still an unknown.

Of course.

Besides that.

There was also the matter of the Galaxy Master being too well-protected by human civilization.

In fact, since the Martial Tao evolution pathway uploaded the Tenth Tier Chapter and became the tenth evolution pathway of human civilization,

some ultimate Level Twelve beings of the different races began to sense that something was amiss.

But human civilization protected the Galaxy Master too well, and even if a Level Twelve being from another race was willing to forsake their pride and attack covertly, there was no opportunity.

Many considerations later, the Martial Tao evolution pathway advanced to the Level Eleven pathway, becoming the fifth evolution pathway of human civilization.

Only at this moment did the Level Twelve apexes of different races realize the true potential and terror of the Martial Tao evolution pathway.

“Now it’s not a matter of knowing or not, but how to deal with it.”

The Insect Queen furrowed her brows; the fact that the Galaxy Master was the founder of the Martial Tao evolution pathway was most troublesome for the Insect Race.
